coverageAreas.title: First-launch privacy choice
coverageAreas.notes: The review bundle exposes an explicit decline path, exits the visible ability, and keeps consent unresolved after relaunch.

cases.title: Show explicit accept and decline choices on first launch
preconditions: Fresh installation of the exact committed HAP
steps: Inspect the visible dialog and UI tree
assertions: Accept is visible and disabled until the agreement checkbox is selected
failureSignals: Accept is enabled without explicit agreement

cases.title: Exit the visible app when privacy consent is declined
steps: Inspect the foreground ability and UI tree
assertions: ZhuoBrowser no longer owns the visible foreground ability
failureSignals: Decline dismisses the gate and exposes browser UI

cases.title: Keep consent unresolved after decline and relaunch
preconditions: Privacy consent was declined in the previous launch

results.notes: UI tree showed privacy-consent-decline as visible/enabled at [117,2025][527,2163] and privacy-consent-accept as visible/disabled at [557,2025][967,2163].

evidence.summary: Both actions were legible and fully inside the 1084 x 2412 display.

results.notes: After tapping the center of privacy-consent-decline, com.youdroid.browser left the foreground and the prior app became visible. The process remained cached in BACKGROUND without a visible ability.

evidence.summary: The post-decline UI tree contained no com.youdroid.browser window.

results.notes: Relaunch showed the same unresolved privacy gate with decline enabled and accept disabled, proving that decline did not persist acceptance.

evidence.summary: The app was intentionally left at the unresolved privacy gate after verification.

validation.summary: Canonical profile and certificate validated; IAP capability enabled.
Exact commit built and signed successfully in an isolated worktree.
Fresh installation and launch of com.youdroid.browser succeeded.
Visible control states, decline exit, and relaunch persistence were verified.

lastRun.notes: The historical com.youdroid.zhuobrowser debug package was cleared and removed. The canonical review build installs as com.youdroid.browser. No accept action was performed, so the device remains at the first-launch privacy gate.
